clauses.requirement: For retro-reflectors (a retro-reflective device under UN R150 para 4.1), the specific requirements of para 4.1.6 apply, namely those in paras 4.1.6.1 and 4.1.6.2.
A retro-reflector may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which shall be designed so that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

Colorimetric test conditions: the retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements of sections 5 (General specifications) and 6 (Individual specifications) and the referenced Annexes of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval, pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the vehicle category on which it is installed.
Night-time colour of the retro-reflective device shall be verified using the test procedure for night time colours specified in para 4.2.1 (paras 4.2.1.1 to 4.2.1.3).
The night-time colour test specifications of para 4.2.1 apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices.

When testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, illuminate it with CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0°, or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, with an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1; the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the retro-reflected light defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

White retro-reflective devices shall not produce a selective reflection: the trichromatic coordinates x and y of Standard Illuminant A used to illuminate the device shall not change by more than 0.01 after reflection by the device.
